items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Jack Mahoney wrote the words and Percy Winrich wrote the music.

ctx.x: See I have all his books that we played in in Chicago. That is they read um what they called it orchestration. I have all the books of orchestration. See they had to play orchestration.
